tags.name: Ai chat
tags.description: The Ask AI assistant in the admin console, and the writes it proposes.

post.summary: Confirm the latest exposed review of this owned active session
post.description: No client body. Session-first operation claim commits before execution with current caller credentials. Unknown confirmed outcomes remain blocked, never replayed. Returns only executed and sanitized isError, not raw tool results.

404.description: not_found (including same-owner other-session, hidden or deleted links)

409.description: session_archived, session_busy, review_replaced, revision_conflict or not_pending

post.summary: Cancel the latest exposed review of this owned active session

post.description: Send the conversation to the assistant. The assistant may read this tenant with the caller's token, and may propose writes. Proposed writes are returned in `actions` and run only after the user confirms them. Landing-page tools additionally require a Cloud API token for the same user with landing-page editing permission.

parameters.name: x-landing-page-authorization
parameters.description: Bearer Cloud API token used only for landing-page tools. Must belong to the authenticated caller and carry manage:landing:page or all. Never sent to the model or stored with proposals.

200.description: The assistant's reply, and any writes it proposed.

503.description: The assistant is not configured or could not answer.

post.description: Store a write as a pending action. Nothing is created here. The stored body is returned for review, and the write runs only when the user confirms the action. Landing-page draft reviews last 30 minutes from proposal creation; other write reviews last 5 minutes. An expired landing draft can be proposed again with the same validated draft body to refresh its review. This creates a new action ID and still requires an explicit confirmation; it never saves, publishes, or merges newer edits automatically.

201.description: The pending action, with the body that will be sent on confirm.

400.description: The tool is not a write tool, or the arguments do not fit it.

post.description: Run a pending action once, with the body stored when it was proposed. Linked session actions additionally require an active owned session, exposed latest review and shared approval lease; hidden and deleted links cannot execute. The caller's bearer token is used for Management API calls. Saving a landing-page draft instead requires the same user's Cloud API token, revalidated at confirmation time.

parameters.name: x-landing-page-authorization
parameters.description: Bearer Cloud API token required when confirming a landing-page draft save; belongs to the caller and carries landing-page editing permission.

200.description: The action ran. `result` is the Management API response.

400.description: The action's tool is no longer available.

404.description: No such action for this user.

409.description: The action was already run or cancelled, its body was changed, or its linked session is archived/busy or review was replaced.

410.description: The action expired before it was confirmed.

post.description: Cancel a proposed write that has not been confirmed yet.

404.description: No pending action with this id for this user.

409.description: Linked session is archived/busy, review replaced or invalid body.
